name: SantaCoder
description:
Here is how to read the SantaCoder config.json. The architecture class is GPT2LMHeadCustomModel, which is the transformers (or equivalent) module that wires embeddings, attention, the MLP, and the language-modelling head that turns hidden states into next-token logits.

hidden_size is 2,048: that is the width of every residual stream vector. The embedding matrix is therefore 49,280 × 2,048: each token id owns a vector of that width.

num_attention_heads is 16, so each head sees 128 dimensions (2,048 / 16). The ratio test is hidden_size / num_attention_heads = 2048 / 16 = 128. 128 is a multiple of 32 (NVIDIA warp-friendly), and a multiple of 16 (Huawei cube-friendly), and a power of two (Triton / FlashAttention-friendly). From this number alone you cannot name the training chip.

num_hidden_layers is 24: the stack is that many transformer blocks deep.

intermediate_size is 8,192. In a SwiGLU MLP this is the high-dimensional workspace: the 2,048-wide stream is projected up, activated, then projected back. Labs usually round this width to a multiple of 128 or 256 so it tiles on the chip.

vocab_size is 49,280. 49,280 is divisible by 128. bos/eos ids, when present, are just two special rows in that table; the padded vocab is often larger than the tokenizer’s real inventory.

torch_dtype is float32.

The copy of config.json is from https://huggingface.co/bigcode/santacoder/blob/main/config.json.
